title: Pack With Me ✧ cute essentials, OOTDs 🎀 + aesthetic travel vlog 5D4N ✈️
description:
✨ Come with me as I pack all my cute essentials for this trip and explore Vietnam for 5 days! From cozy trains to scenic mountains, pho noodles every day, Sapa’s dreamy vibes, and the breathtaking views of Ha Long Bay
this trip was unforgettable!

I also share my travel outfits and little joyful moments along the way 🧳☁️🌸

🎥 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe if you enjoy my travel diaries with a cozy + aesthetic touch!🌸
